Amanehunu berɛ
1 # 1 Ti 4.1 Na hunu yei sɛ, nna a ɛdi akyire mu no, mmerɛ a emu yɛ den bɛba. 2Ɛfiri sɛ nnipa bɛyɛ ahopɛfoɔ, sikapɛfoɔ, ahohoahoafoɔ, ahantanfoɔ, abususɛnkafoɔ, awofoɔ asɛm ho asoɔdenfoɔ, bonniayɛfoɔ, wɔn a biribiara ho nte mma wɔn, 3wɔn a wɔnni tema, apamsɛefoɔ, nsekubɔfoɔ, wɔn a wɔnhyɛ wɔn akɔnnɔ soɔ, wɔn a wɔyɛ werɛmfoɔ, wɔn a wɔmpɛ papa, 4#Flp 3.19 afatwafoɔ, akakabenfoɔ, wɔn a wɔhoran, wɔn a wɔdɔ anigyedeɛ sene Onyankopɔn, 5#Mat 7.15; 7.21; Tito 1.16 wɔkekare wɔn anim kyerɛ onyamesom pa, nanso wɔpa emu ahoɔden. Saa nnipa yi, dane wo ho firi wɔn ho!
6 # Mat 23.14; Tito 1.11 Na yeinom mu bi ne wɔn a wɔnam aseɛ hyɛnehyɛne afie mu, na wɔfa mmaa adwenemharefoɔ a bɔne adɔre ahyɛ wɔn soɔ, a akɔnnɔ ahodoɔ keka wɔn no nnommum, 7wɔn a wɔsua daa, nanso wɔntumi nhunu nokorɛ no da.
Kyiri a wɔkyiri nokorɛ
8 # Eks 7.11; 7.22 Na sɛdeɛ Yane ne Yambrɛ ne Mose dii asie no, saa ara na yeinom nso ne nokorɛ no di asie. Wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔn adwene asɛeɛ; wɔmfra wɔ gyidie fam. 9Nso wɔrenkɔ wɔn anim pii biara, na wɔn gyimi bɛda adi nnipa nyinaa anim, sɛdeɛ wɔn deɛ no nso yɛeɛ no.
Paulo amanehunu
10Na wo deɛ, woadi me nkyerɛkyerɛ, me bra, me tirimbɔ, me gyidie, m’abodwokyɛre, me dɔ, me boasetɔ, 11#Aso 13.50; 14.5; 14.19; Dwom 34.19 me taa a wɔanya me ntaaeɛ, m’amanehunu a ɛbaa me so Antiokia, Ikonium ne Listra no akyi. Saa ɔtaa yi na megyinaa mu, na Awurade gyee me firii ne nyinaa mu. 12#Mat 16.24; Aso 14.22 Na wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde onyamesom pa tena ase Kristo Yesu mu nyinaa, wɔbɛtaa wɔn. 13#1 Ti 4.1 Na nnipa bɔne asisifoɔ bɛkɔ wɔn anim wɔ bɔne mu, wɔdaadaa na wɔdaadaa wɔn.
Ɔkae Timoteo ne mmɔfraase adesua
14 # 2 Ti 2.2 Na wo deɛ, tena deɛ woasua no na woahunu afiri nokorɛ no mu. Wonim onii ko a wosua firii ne nkyɛn no, 15#Yoh 5.39 na wofiri wo mmɔfraase nim atwerɛ kronkron no a ɛbɛtumi ama woahunu nyansa afa Kristo Yesu mu gyidie soɔ akɔ nkwagyeɛ mu. 16#2 Pe 1.19-21 Atwerɛ nyinaa firi Nyankopɔn home mu, na ɛyɛ ma nkyerɛkyerɛ, atɛnyie, atenetene ne tenenee mu nteteeɛ. 17#1 Ti 6.11 Na Nyankopɔn nipa ayɛ pɛ a wɔasiesie no koraa ama nnwuma pa nyinaa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na hunu yei sɛ, nna a ɛdi akyire mu no, mmerɛ a emu yɛ den bɛba. Ɛfiri sɛ nnipa bɛyɛ ahopɛfoɔ, sikapɛfoɔ, ahohoahoafoɔ, ahantanfoɔ, abususɛnkafoɔ, awofoɔ asɛm ho asoɔdenfoɔ, bonniayɛfoɔ, wɔn a biribiara ho nte mma wɔn, wɔn a wɔnni tema, apamsɛefoɔ, nsekubɔfoɔ, wɔn a wɔnhyɛ wɔn akɔnnɔ soɔ, wɔn a wɔyɛ werɛmfoɔ, wɔn a wɔmpɛ papa, afatwafoɔ, akakabenfoɔ, wɔn a wɔhoran, wɔn a wɔdɔ anigyedeɛ sene Onyankopɔn, wɔkekare wɔn anim kyerɛ onyamesom pa, nanso wɔpa emu ahoɔden. Saa nnipa yi, dane wo ho firi wɔn ho!
Na yeinom mu bi ne wɔn a wɔnam aseɛ hyɛnehyɛne afie mu, na wɔfa mmaa adwenemharefoɔ a bɔne adɔre ahyɛ wɔn soɔ, a akɔnnɔ ahodoɔ keka wɔn no nnommum, wɔn a wɔsua daa, nanso wɔntumi nhunu nokorɛ no da.

Na sɛdeɛ Yane ne Yambrɛ ne Mose dii asie no, saa ara na yeinom nso ne nokorɛ no di asie. Wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔn adwene asɛeɛ; wɔmfra wɔ gyidie fam. Nso wɔrenkɔ wɔn anim pii biara, na wɔn gyimi bɛda adi nnipa nyinaa anim, sɛdeɛ wɔn deɛ no nso yɛeɛ no.

Na wo deɛ, woadi me nkyerɛkyerɛ, me bra, me tirimbɔ, me gyidie, m’abodwokyɛre, me dɔ, me boasetɔ, me taa a wɔanya me ntaaeɛ, m’amanehunu a ɛbaa me so Antiokia, Ikonium ne Listra no akyi. Saa ɔtaa yi na megyinaa mu, na Awurade gyee me firii ne nyinaa mu. Na wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde onyamesom pa tena ase Kristo Yesu mu nyinaa, wɔbɛtaa wɔn. Na nnipa bɔne asisifoɔ bɛkɔ wɔn anim wɔ bɔne mu, wɔdaadaa na wɔdaadaa wɔn.

Na wo deɛ, tena deɛ woasua no na woahunu afiri nokorɛ no mu. Wonim onii ko a wosua firii ne nkyɛn no, na wofiri wo mmɔfraase nim atwerɛ kronkron no a ɛbɛtumi ama woahunu nyansa afa Kristo Yesu mu gyidie soɔ akɔ nkwagyeɛ mu. Atwerɛ nyinaa firi Nyankopɔn home mu, na ɛyɛ ma nkyerɛkyerɛ, atɛnyie, atenetene ne tenenee mu nteteeɛ. Na Nyankopɔn nipa ayɛ pɛ a wɔasiesie no koraa ama nnwuma pa nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
